body: Amara S021 claims B-2026-11-02-2, the owner's 2026-11-02 advisor exchange (follow-on to S020's Todo Planning & Hierarchical Execution): the todo list must EVOLVE when execution evidence changes the work. Three deliverables — (1) an explicit `retired` status so a discovery that moots a todo retires it with the discovery in its result instead of silently vanishing in a full-replace; (2) the revision diff surfaced — the loop diffs each todo_write against the live list and emits `todo_revised` (added/retired/kept) to the Todos panel, so a plan that changes shape mid-turn is visible to the user (the adaptive-planning behaviour the exchange benchmarked); (3) an objective-fidelity judge at the close — a bounded read-only lane in the completion-judge shape asking whether the reply addresses the ORIGINAL request (not merely the executed todos), one drift nudge, on the record, never blocks. Recon verified live: the todo pipeline (tool → loop emit → bridge persist/SSE → panel), the four `_emit_todo_write_events` call sites all inside `_run_impl` (a local mirror threads cleanly), the store accepts arbitrary status strings (no migration needed), the sweep's closed-status check, and the shared judge nudge site with its one-shot guard.
